title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - Factory
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/Factory . A subclass of the external s4bldg:Building class (SAREF4BLDG), specialized for SAREF4INMA: a factory represents one or more organizations sharing a definite mission, goals and objectives, which provides an output such as a product (definition taken from IEC 62264). A factory can be divided into one or multiple sites.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Factory'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasSpace.description: Relationship. The sites this factory is divided into. Object property reused from the imported SAREF4BLDG ontology (s4bldg:hasSpace, not redefined in the SAREF4INMA ttl itself); included here because Figure 3/8 of ETSI TS 103 410-5 explicitly uses it to structure the factory/site/area/work-center hierarchy. Target model: 'Site'.
